title: Actions related to reception of UEAssistanceInformationSidelink message

entities.name: UEAssistanceInformationSidelink message
entities.description: Message containing sidelink DRX assistance information transmitted between peer UEs for sidelink communication.

entities.name: Sidelink DRX assistance information
entities.description: DRX assistance parameters provided by a UE to assist in sidelink DRX configuration determination.

entities.name: SL-DRX-ConfigUC
entities.description: Sidelink DRX configuration determined for unicast communication with a peer UE.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED state
entities.description: RRC state where UE has an active connection with the network.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE does not have an active connection with the network.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE state
entities.description: RRC state where UE is inactive but maintains some connection context.

entities.name: Resource allocation mode 1
entities.description: Sidelink resource allocation mode where network schedules resources for sidelink communication.

entities.name: Resource allocation mode 2
entities.description: Sidelink resource allocation mode where UE autonomously selects resources for sidelink communication.

entities.name: Out of coverage condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is not within network coverage.

entities.name: Sidelink unicast DRX configuration determination
entities.description: Procedure where a UE determines sidelink DRX configuration for its peer UE based on received assistance information.

relations.description: UEAssistanceInformationSidelink message contains sidelink DRX assistance information.
Sidelink DRX configuration determination procedure requires UE to be in RRC_CONNECTED state for resource allocation mode 1.
Sidelink DRX configuration determination is guarded by resource allocation mode 1 condition for reporting to network.
Sidelink DRX configuration determination is guarded by resource allocation mode 2 condition for autonomous determination.
Sidelink DRX configuration determination requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE state for autonomous determination.
Sidelink DRX configuration determination requires UE to be in RRC_INACTIVE state for autonomous determination.
Sidelink DRX configuration determination is guarded by out of coverage condition for autonomous determination.
Sidelink DRX configuration determination takes sidelink DRX assistance information into account.
Sidelink DRX configuration determination procedure establishes the SL-DRX-ConfigUC for the peer UE.
